summary: Phase 2 state/action model for the SO↔MO linkage contract (revised per state-model-review.json). Models three coupled state machines: (1) Sales Order lifecycle keyed on persisted (status, cancelledAt, deletedAt) tuples (open/cancelled/done states with no 'draft' literal), (2) Manufacturing Order lifecycle keyed on persisted (status, completedAt, cancelledAt, deletedAt, pickAllocations, batches) tuples (active/picking-or-batch-started/done/cancelled-soft-deleted states with no 'released' literal in the column), and (3) the salesOrderLineId one-time-claim sub-state (UNCLAIMED → CLAIMED-BY-ACTIVE-MO → either CLAIMED-BY-FINALIZED-MO (permanent) or back to UNCLAIMED via cancellation per BR-1). All transitions, blocked transitions, and gaps are grounded in file:line citations from evidence.json and contract.json. Captures the post-948c155e regression class (RA-2c silent SO line rewrite while MO has pick allocations), the RA-12 row-lock serialization on bulk create with explicit anti-duplication observables (T05), the BR-5 item-soft-delete block, the BR-6 SO-delete drift guard, and the BR-8a/BR-8b idempotency-key asymmetry. Revision-2 additions: T05 anti-duplication observables (CI-1), T19b CLAIM_STALE_SNAPSHOT→CLAIM_UNCLAIMED via deleteMO and T18b CLAIM_STALE_SNAPSHOT→CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO via completeMO (CI-2 / MI-1 / MI-2), T13a (batch-mode-only reachable cancel) + T13b_unreachable (pick-induced cancel blocked by consumption event guard) replacing the conflated T13 (CI-3), ledger-row-count observables on T02/T23/T24 with explicit BR-8b duplicate observable on T24 (CI-4), bulkConfirmSalesOrders action + T27 transition (CI-5), T_OUT_OF_SCOPE_SO_DONE_FULLSHIP stub for SO_OPEN→SO_DONE (II-1), recalibrated T09/T10 confidence with corrected T09 observable (pickedQuantity not actualQuantity) (II-3), T24 demoted to experimental with Phase 4 verification flag (II-4), GAP-claim-finalized-permanent for BR-1 terminality (II-5), and GAP-different-itemId-rewrite updated to cross-reference T19b/T18b (II-6). Does not enumerate low-level DOM events.

inferences.claim: The conceptual 'released' MO state has no direct column flag. It is implicitly represented by the existence of at least one pickAllocation row OR a non-pending manufacturingOrderBatches row for the MO. The MO's `status` remains 'open' until completion sets `status='done'+completedAt`. The edit:work_started guard (queries.ts:3877-3882) is the canonical detector.

RA-2c is a 'no guard exists' case: updateSalesOrder does not query the manufacturingOrders or pickAllocations tables before hard-deleting salesOrderLines. The SO line rewrite silently succeeds; the resulting drift only manifests later (next MO edit attempt or SO delete attempt). Direct code verification: grep for 'pickAllocation' inside app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts returns zero matches.

A cancelled MO (deletedAt SET, status still 'open' typically) reopens the salesOrderLineId claim because the existing_active_mo filter at sales-order-manufacturability.ts:222-235 requires deletedAt IS NULL. A 'done' MO cannot be cancelled (finalized guard) so its claim is permanent. Therefore the only realistic path back to UNCLAIMED is cancellation of an active MO.

Concurrent bulk Create-MOs-from-SO submissions against the same SO serialize via FOR UPDATE on salesOrders. The second caller sees an updated summary on lock release; whether it returns 409 'refresh_required' or silently returns {created:[], skipped:[...existing_active_mo]} depends on whether its original payload still names lines that the first caller claimed.

POST /api/manufacturing-orders (single create) is NOT serialized by the SO row lock. Two concurrent direct-create POSTs that both claim the same salesOrderLineId can interleave; the first to commit wins, the second's validateSalesLineLinkInTx may still resolve the line as 'open' because validateSalesLineLinkInTx does not FOR UPDATE the line and does not check existing_active_mo at all (that check is summary-only). Outcome of double-claim race depends on transaction commit timing.
based_on: app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts:729-819 (no existing_active_mo check, no FOR UPDATE on line)

unknowns: Exact body of moveReplacedSalesLineAllocationsInTx: whether it matches by (itemId, sortOrder), (itemId only), or by quantity. Not opened in Phase 0/1/2.
Whether validateSalesLineLinkInTx is called at any point during MO release/pick beyond MO edit. If not, a stale snapshot persists invisibly across pick/release until MO completion.

What happens when POST /api/manufacturing-orders is retried with the SAME request body and no idempotency key but the first commit succeeded: insertManufacturingOrderInTx allocates an orderNumber from a sequence, so two rows with distinct orderNumbers + distinct ids are created. Whether the second succeeds in linking to the same salesOrderLineId depends on transaction order — a parallel race might allow it; a serial retry hits getSalesOrderManufacturingSummariesInTx-style filters only on the bulk path, not on direct create.

states.name: SO_NONE
states.description: Sales order does not exist yet. No row in salesOrders.
visible_indicators: No row in salesOrders table for the given id
invariants: No linkable salesOrderLineId can exist

states.name: SO_OPEN
states.description: Active sales order. status='open' AND deletedAt IS NULL. Reservations are live; visible in pickers and previews; eligible for bulk Create MOs.
entry_conditions: createSalesOrder commits successfully (status forced to 'open' by schema transform)
Note: confirmSalesOrder does not enter this state — the order is already SO_OPEN from creation
invariants: Every salesOrderLine has an active reservation written by reserveForSalesInTx
Schema-forced status='open' — no 'draft' literal exists in DB

states.name: SO_DONE
states.description: Sales order marked done. status='done' AND deletedAt IS NULL. Cannot be edited (SalesError 'Done orders cannot be changed'). No code path inside the SO↔MO linkage surface transitions to this state — the trigger lives in the shipment / fulfillment domain (see T_OUT_OF_SCOPE_SO_DONE_FULLSHIP).
entry_conditions: Out of scope of this contract — set by shipment / fulfillment flows. Two known entry points: shipSalesOrder at sales/queries.ts:7419-7435 (full single-call ship via POST /api/sales-orders/[id]/ship), and shipSalesShipment at sales/queries.ts:7172-7185 (when the final shipment closes the order via POST /api/sales-orders/[id]/shipments/[shipmentId]/ship). Modeled as T_OUT_OF_SCOPE_SO_DONE_FULLSHIP so downstream tests have a documented path to drive SO_OPEN → SO_DONE for the blocked-transitions assertions.
visible_indicators: getManufacturingSalesOrderPreview returns null → GET API returns 404
invariants: updateSalesOrder rejects with 400 'Done orders cannot be changed.'
bulk Create MOs rejects with 400 'Only open sales orders can create manufacturing orders'

states.name: SO_DELETED
states.description: Sales order soft-deleted. deletedAt SET. Hidden from pickers and previews. Linked MOs may have been cascade-soft-deleted alongside (subject to finalized guards).
entry_conditions: deleteSalesOrder commits successfully after passing getSalesOrderDeleteBlockerInTx AND deleteSalesLinkedManufacturingOrdersInTx drift checks
visible_indicators: Excluded from getManufacturingSalesOrderOptions (which filters deletedAt IS NULL)
invariants: All linked non-finalized MOs are also soft-deleted; finalized MOs remain (but their snapshot now points at a deleted SO)

states.name: MO_NONE
states.description: Manufacturing order does not exist yet. No row in manufacturingOrders.
visible_indicators: No row in manufacturingOrders for the given id
invariants: Does not contribute to existing_active_mo filter

states.name: MO_ACTIVE
states.description: Active manufacturing order. status='open' AND deletedAt IS NULL AND completedAt IS NULL AND no pickAllocations AND no non-pending batches. Editable by updateManufacturingOrder. Holds a salesOrderLineId claim if linked.
visible_indicators: deletedAt IS NULL, completedAt IS NULL, cancelledAt IS NULL
No pickAllocation rows for any ingredient
invariants: If salesOrderLineId is non-null, this MO satisfies the existing_active_mo filter and blocks reuse of that sales line
Editable: updateManufacturingOrder does not throw edit:work_started
Snapshot columns salesOrderNumber/salesCustomerName are written on create

states.name: MO_WORK_STARTED
states.description: Active MO with picking or batch work in progress. status still 'open' AND deletedAt IS NULL AND completedAt IS NULL, BUT pickAllocations exist OR at least one batch has status != 'pending'. Edit is blocked. Holds the salesOrderLineId claim.
entry_conditions: POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/batches/[batchId]/start commits a non-pending batch (NOT idempotency-keyed per BR-8b)
visible_indicators: At least one row in manufacturing_order_pick_allocations for this MO, OR at least one manufacturingOrderBatches row with status != 'pending'
invariants: updateManufacturingOrder throws 400 'Orders cannot be edited after picking or batch work starts.'
Still satisfies existing_active_mo (deletedAt IS NULL AND status IN ('open','done'))
If linked, holds the salesOrderLineId claim; a concurrent SO line rewrite leaves a stale snapshot (RA-2c)

states.name: MO_DONE
states.description: Completed MO. status='done' AND completedAt SET AND actualQuantity > 0 AND deletedAt IS NULL. The 'one-time claim' on salesOrderLineId becomes permanent because deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx (queries.ts:6379-6391) refuses to soft-delete a done MO.
entry_conditions: POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/complete (discrete mode) sets status='done', completedAt, actualQuantity
Final batch complete in batch mode also transitions to status='done'
visible_indicators: completedAt SET, actualQuantity > 0, deletedAt IS NULL
invariants: Permanent salesOrderLineId claim — cannot be reopened
deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx refuses to soft-delete (returns finalized error)
updateManufacturingOrder rejects with 400 'Only open orders can be edited'

states.name: MO_CANCELLED
states.description: Soft-deleted MO. deletedAt SET. cancelledAt may also be SET (for released MOs that went through cancelReleasedManufacturingOrderInTx). status typically still 'open' (deletion does not transition status to 'done'). Reopens the salesOrderLineId claim.
entry_conditions: DELETE /api/manufacturing-orders/[id] (single) or bulk delete commits, passing the finalized guard at queries.ts:6379-6391
visible_indicators: cancelledAt may be SET (released MOs) or NULL (never-released open MOs)
status remains 'open' — deletion does not flip status to 'done'
invariants: Excluded from existing_active_mo filter (deletedAt IS NULL fails) → salesOrderLineId returns to UNCLAIMED
stockAllocations for the MO are cancelled
Ingredient reservations released

states.description: salesOrderLineId is not claimed by any active or done MO. Eligible for a new linked MO. Equivalent to: NOT EXISTS (manufacturingOrders WHERE salesOrderLineId = $1 AND deletedAt IS NULL AND status IN ('open','done')).
entry_conditions: Sales line just created (no MO yet)

states.name: CLAIM_ACTIVE_MO
states.description: salesOrderLineId is claimed by exactly one MO in MO_ACTIVE or MO_WORK_STARTED. The claim is reversible via cancellation.
entry_conditions: createManufacturingOrderInTx or createManufacturingOrdersFromSalesOrderInTx writes the link with status='open' default
visible_indicators: skipMessage: 'A linked manufacturing order already exists.'
Linked MO row's salesOrderLineId matches and deletedAt IS NULL
invariants: Bulk Create MOs returns skip with reason 'existing_active_mo' for this line
A second direct-create against the same line will succeed at validateSalesLineLinkInTx (no existing_active_mo guard there) but will create a second row — see state_coverage_gaps

states.name: CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO
states.description: salesOrderLineId is claimed by a done MO (MO_DONE). The claim is permanent because the MO cannot be soft-deleted.
entry_conditions: Linked MO transitioned MO_ACTIVE→MO_WORK_STARTED→MO_DONE via complete
visible_indicators: Linked MO row has status='done', completedAt SET, deletedAt IS NULL
invariants: Cannot return to CLAIM_UNCLAIMED — deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx refuses to soft-delete finalized MOs
Bulk Create MOs permanently skips this line

states.name: CLAIM_STALE_SNAPSHOT
states.description: Anomaly state: a linked MO's salesOrderLineId points at a sales line id that no longer exists (the SO line was rewritten via updateSalesOrder). The salesOrderId still resolves. Snapshot fallback in validateSalesLineLinkInTx may re-bind on next MO edit (T17), but only when the rewritten SO has another line with the same productId AND the MO is still in MO_ACTIVE (edit:work_started blocks otherwise). If no matching line exists, or the MO is in MO_WORK_STARTED, the snapshot stays stale until MO cancel (T19b) or MO complete (T18b → terminal stuck per CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO).
entry_conditions: updateSalesOrder hard-deleted the original salesOrderLine and (a) no replacement with same productId exists (RA-2b), OR (b) MO has pickAllocations or active batches so the next MO edit is blocked before validateSalesLineLinkInTx can rebind (RA-2c). Both reachable via T16 from CLAIM_ACTIVE_MO and via T21 from MO_WORK_STARTED.
visible_indicators: manufacturingOrders.salesOrderLineId points to a row no longer present in salesOrderLines
manufacturingOrders.salesOrderId still resolves to a non-deleted SO
invariants: Snapshot persists invisibly until one of: T17 (rebind on next MO edit), T19b (cancel MO → reopens claim, snapshot row deleted with MO), T18b (complete MO → snapshot persists forever in CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO)
No periodic reconciler exists — without an explicit transition, stale snapshot lingers forever
Cancelling a still-cancellable MO (T19b: deleteMO from CLAIM_STALE_SNAPSHOT) reopens the SO line claim and bypasses the BR-6 drift error on SO delete
Completing the MO (T18b) makes the staleness permanent: the snapshot survives, BR-6 drift guard permanently blocks SO delete, and BR-1 finalized guard refuses any further MO cancel

state_coverage_gaps.concern: BR-8b: POST /api/manufacturing-orders does not require Idempotency-Key. Client retries can create duplicate MOs claiming the same salesOrderLineId. validateSalesLineLinkInTx (queries.ts:729-819) does not consult existing_active_mo so the second insert succeeds at the validation layer. Whether the second insert actually commits depends on transaction-level commit ordering and any unique constraints — manufacturingOrders has no uniqueIndex on (salesOrderLineId), so duplicates are NOT prevented by the database. The model (T24) predicts two rows result from rapid duplicate POST without an Idempotency-Key header but flags this as a Phase 4 experimental verification: tests must observe the actual commit outcome and either (a) confirm two rows with the same salesOrderLineId, or (b) discover an undocumented serialization that prevents the second commit. The model does NOT assume which outcome occurs.

state_coverage_gaps.concern: CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO is terminal per BR-1's 'in practice' clarifier. deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx (queries.ts:6379-6391) refuses to soft-delete a finalized MO ('Cannot delete manufacturing order {N} because production output has already been recorded. Production history must be preserved.'), so completing an MO permanently consumes the salesOrderLineId claim. There is no admin override, no force-cancel, no claim-release endpoint, and no validateSalesLineLinkInTx call in the complete path — so the snapshot does not even get refreshed at completion. If a user accidentally completes an MO against the wrong sales line, or completes an MO whose SO line has been rewritten (CLAIM_STALE_SNAPSHOT → CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO via T18b), the only recourse is a manual DB edit.
